headline: Approved Policy B8 on electronic communication between employees and students; tabled Policy G9 on student activities fund management.
summary: The committee approved Policy B8 on electronic communication between employees and students for action by the full Board at its next meeting. Policy G9 on student activities fund management was tabled until the next meeting. Policy H6 on use of school facilities will be reviewed again at the next meeting.
decisions: Approved Policy B8 on electronic communication between employees and students for action by the full Board at its next meeting.
Tabled Policy G9 on student activities fund management until the next meeting.
Continued Policy H6 on use of school facilities to the next meeting, to be reviewed with the procedures now in place.

BSD Policy & Governance Committee Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Champlain Elementary School - Library 800 Pine Street 
Commissioners Present: Jeff Wick, Chair, Lucia Campriello, Polly Vanderputten 
Staff Present: BSD HR Specialist Kathy Finck, Executive Director of Finance Nate Lavery 
 
 
1. Opening  
1.1 Call meeting to order 
6:15pm  
1.2 Suspend Robert's Rules 
 
2. Public Comment 
None 
 
3. Discussion  
3.1 Policy H6 - Use of School Facilities 
The committee will review again at next meeting along 
with the Procedures that are now in place.  
3.2 Policy G9 - Student Activities Fund Management 
Tabled until next meeting.  
3.3 Policy B8 - Electronic Communication between Employees and Students 
The committee discussed and approved this policy for action by the full Board at the next 
Board 
meeting. 
   
3.4 Two additional policies were reviewed for updating: 
C10 – Policy for Investigation and Response to Harassment, Hazing, and Bullying of 
Students: 
The 9/4/26 AOE Model Policy was discussed; further discussion is warranted about the 
BSD 
additions that may be included. 
  
 
4. Adjournment 
7:32pm
